Cisco's static analyzer only: signature (YAML/YARA) rules and Python checks over the files.
Static analyzer plus Cisco's behavioral dataflow analyzer over the skill's scripts.

Behavioral baseline plus Cisco's LLM Analyzer (--use-llm): one LLM call per scan over SKILL.md, manifest, code and referenced files within Cisco's prompt budgets, enriched with the deterministic findings. Static/behavioral findings are unchanged; LLM findings carry analyzer 'llm'. Results depend on the model recorded in run_metadata.json.

Behavioral baseline plus Cisco's Meta-Analyzer (--enable-meta) without the LLM Analyzer. Meta post-processes the deterministic findings: it is skipped when there are none, makes no LLM call when every finding is clear deterministic evidence, and otherwise marks findings as false positives (kept here via --verbose) or adds 'missed threats'. It never changes severity.
B plus the Meta-Analyzer over all findings, including the LLM Analyzer's. The LLM Analyzer runs again inside this scan, so its findings can differ from B's (see llm_run_stability).
